Based on the given passages, here is how you can charge your phone from your laptop:

1. Make sure your laptop is awake and the phone is connected to the laptop via a USB cable.
2. Check that the phone is actually charging by verifying the battery level of the phone.
3. If the laptop is asleep, wake it up before attempting to charge the phone.
4. If you have plugged the phone into a USB port on the laptop, make sure that the USB port is not disabled in the power management settings. To do this, go to Device Manager, find the USB port the phone is connected to, right-click the name, select Properties, and then select Power Management. Deselect the first box to prevent the computer from turning off the device.
5. Plug your laptop into a power outlet using its power charger.
6. Start up the computer and log in (if required). Once the computer is active, it will begin to charge your phone.

Note that the specific steps may vary depending on the type of laptop and phone you are using. It is always a good idea to consult the user manual for your specific devices for more detailed instructions.
